name: build-npm-package

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      node-version:
        description: Node.js version for the build
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '22'
      package-name:
        description: Optional override for the package name
        required: false
        type: string
      package-version:
        description: Optional override for the package version
        required: false
        type: string
    outputs:
      version:
        description: Package version used for the build
        value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.version }}
      tarball:
        description: Path to the packed tarball artifact
        value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.tarball }}
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      node-version:
        description: Node.js version for the build
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '22'
      package-name:
        description: Optional override for the package name
        required: false
        type: string
      package-version:
        description: Optional override for the package version
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    env:
      PNPM_CONFIG_VERIFY_DEPS_BEFORE_RUN: 'false'

    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}
      tarball: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.tarball }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: ${{ inputs.node-version }}
          cache: pnpm

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Resolve package version
        if: inputs.package-version != ''
        id: resolved_version
        run: |
          version="${{ inputs.package-version }}"
          version="${version#v}"
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Set package version
        if: inputs.package-version != ''
        run: |
          jq --arg version "${{ steps.resolved_version.outputs.version }}" '.version=$version' package.json > package.json.tmp
          mv package.json.tmp package.json

      - name: Override package name
        if: inputs.package-name != ''
        run: |
          jq --arg name "${{ inputs.package-name }}" '.name=$name' package.json > package.json.tmp
          mv package.json.tmp package.json

      - run: pnpm run build

      - name: Remove prepare script
        run: jq 'del(.scripts.prepare)' package.json > package.json.tmp && mv package.json.tmp package.json

      - name: Capture package metadata
        id: meta
        run: echo "version=$(jq -r .version package.json)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Pack build output
        id: pack
        env:
          npm_config_ignore_scripts: 'true'
          npm_config_loglevel: 'error'
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts
          pnpm pack --pack-destination artifacts
          tarball=$(ls artifacts/*.tgz | head -n 1)
          echo "tarball=$tarball" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Upload package artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: npm-package
          path: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.tarball }}
          if-no-files-found: error

        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
